title: Multi-dimensional models
intro: Beams (1D), plates (2D) and solids (3D) in the same model. The families are joined at shared structural nodes whose expansion is Taylor of order 0 (the only expansion with the same number of terms on sections of any dimension); the tests have a closed-form solution (nu = 0, uniform axial stress 4.0e+06 Pa, tip displacement 3 sigma / E).
